Section 6 DDKtor Once you have all raw data in ddktor-dbs/data/raw, you are ready to run the DDKtor pipeline. Make sure your working directory is ddktor-dbs. Run the following commands to check installation and run the pipeline: chmod +x check_installations.sh ./check_installations.sh If everything is correctly installed, the terminal will print All good :) Run the main shell script: $ chmod +x ./run_script.sh ./run_script.sh To process with noise reduction, run ./run_script.sh -n A successful run should look like the following: Screenshot of a successful ddktor script run. If you encounter errors saying that certain packages are missing, install them by typing into the terminal pip install [package] without the brackets.
